title: Cylindrical base
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees in all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. For the first two-dimensional sketch, draw a single circle on the first face within the first loop. Place the center of the circle at coordinates (0.0319, 0.0319) and set the radius to 0.0319 units. Apply a scale factor of 0.0638 to the entire two-dimensional sketch to adjust its size accordingly. Transform the scaled sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translating it using the translation vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Next, extrude the two-dimensional sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units without extending it in the opposite direction. Perform a boolean operation to create a new solid body from this extrusion. The resulting cylindrical base will have a length of 0.0637722 units, a width of 0.0637722 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0319, 0.0319)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0319)  # Draw a circle with the specified radius
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylindrical body
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# The final model
r = cylinder

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Dimensions
diameter = 0.0638
radius = diameter / 2.0
total_height = 0.75
cyl_height = total_height - radius  # straight portion below the rounded top

# Part 1: Main cylindrical body
part_1 = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(radius).extrude(cyl_height)

# Part 2: Hemispherical rounded top
part_2 = cq.Workplane("XY").sphere(radius).translate((0, 0, cyl_height))

# Combine the body and the rounded top
r = part_1.union(part_2)
